name: Symbol of Despair, Greater
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [despair, emotion, mind-affecting]; Level cleric/oracle 7, sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 7

CASTING

Components V, S, M (mercury and phosphorous, plus powdered diamond and opal worth a total of 5,000 gp)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as symbol of despair, except for the above and affected creatures are subject to the hopeless condition.

Greater symbol of despair can be made permanent with a permanency spell CL 15+ for the cost of 17,000 gp.
